compute_optical_flow_with_flownet2: run Flownet2 on frame pairs to compute optical flow using a specified checkpoint model
warp_image_by_flow: warp a color image using an optical flow field with torch-based geometry sampling
filter_good_flow_pairs: filter frame pairs by overlap ratio using mask coverage to find valid flow pairs
visualize_flow_with_masks: visualize optical flow fields alongside color images with optional warping and mask overlays
mask_valid_correspondences: generate consistency masks for valid flow correspondences using flow and color thresholds
